newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to make foreign currency issue in 96 - Caruana.
newsitem.headline: Spain to make foreign currency issue in 96 - Caruana.

text.p: Spain will make a foreign currency issue this year to cover the 1995 budget hole and might make a foreign currency commercial paper issue as well, Treasury director Jaime Caruana told a Spanish daily in an interview published on Friday.
Financial daily La Gaceta de los Negocios quoted Caruana as saying 521 billion pesetas needed to be covered of the 721 billion hole the government discovered in July.

"Of these, about 350 billion or so we are going to finance through issues in foreign currencies and the rest in issues denominated in pesetas. To cover this sum, we will turn, before the end of the year, to another issue in foreign currencies and perhaps a commerical paper issue in foreign currencies," Caruana said.
